name: DDL/表锁诊断 — DDL 锁与表级锁的排查
description: DDL 操作需要获取表级排他锁（TM enqueue mode 6）和 Library Cache Lock，可能阻塞并发 DML 或被活跃 DML 阻塞。本规则诊断 DDL 锁等待、表级锁争用（TM enqueue），以及 Online DDL（12c+）的使用场景。

conditions.desc: TM enqueue 等待 > 10 次/分钟

skip_when.desc: 无 DDL 操作且 TM 等待 = 0

root_causes.name: DDL 被活跃 DML 阻塞
root_causes.desc: DDL（ALTER TABLE, DROP INDEX 等）需要获取表级排他锁，但有活跃的 DML 事务持有行锁或表级共享锁。DDL 必须等所有 DML 完成。

root_causes.name: DDL 阻塞后续 DML
root_causes.desc: DDL 排队等锁时，后续的 DML 也被阻塞（DDL 请求排他锁会阻塞新的共享锁请求）。连锁效应导致大量会话排队。

root_causes.name: 未使用 Online DDL
root_causes.desc: 12c+ 支持 Online DDL（ALTER TABLE ... ONLINE），可以在不阻塞 DML 的情况下完成大部分 DDL。未使用导致不必要的锁阻塞。

root_causes.name: Library Cache Lock 等待
root_causes.desc: DDL 需要获取对象的 Library Cache Lock（排他模式），正在执行引用该对象的 SQL 的会话持有共享 LC Lock。

step1_check_ddl_waits.desc: 检查 DDL 相关锁等待
step1_check_ddl_waits.sql: SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.sql_id, s.event, s.blocking_session, s.seconds_in_wait, q.sql_text FROM v$session s LEFT JOIN v$sql q ON s.sql_id = q.sql_id AND q.child_number = 0 WHERE s.event LIKE 'enq: TM%' OR s.event LIKE 'library cache%' OR s.command IN (2,5,6,7,9,10,11,15) AND s.state = 'WAITING' ORDER BY s.seconds_in_wait DESC

step2_check_tm_enqueue.desc: 检查 TM enqueue 争用详情
step2_check_tm_enqueue.sql: SELECT l.sid, l.type, l.id1, l.id2, l.lmode, l.request, o.owner, o.object_name, o.object_type FROM v$lock l LEFT JOIN DBA_OBJECTS o ON l.id1 = o.object_id WHERE l.type = 'TM' AND (l.lmode > 0 OR l.request > 0) ORDER BY l.id1, l.lmode DESC

step3_check_blocker_chain.sql: SELECT LPAD(' ', 2*(level-1)) || sid sid_tree, serial#, username, event, blocking_session, sql_id, seconds_in_wait FROM v$session START WITH blocking_session IS NULL AND sid IN (SELECT blocking_session FROM v$session WHERE blocking_session IS NOT NULL) CONNECT BY PRIOR sid = blocking_session ORDER SIBLINGS BY seconds_in_wait DESC

step4_check_object_locks.sql: SELECT s.sid, s.serial#, s.username, s.program, l.type, DECODE(l.lmode,0,'None',1,'Null',2,'RS',3,'RX',4,'S',5,'SRX',6,'X',l.lmode) lock_mode, DECODE(l.request,0,'None',1,'Null',2,'RS',3,'RX',4,'S',5,'SRX',6,'X',l.request) request_mode, o.object_name FROM v$lock l JOIN v$session s ON l.sid = s.sid LEFT JOIN DBA_OBJECTS o ON l.id1 = o.object_id WHERE l.type = 'TM' AND o.object_name = '&table_name' ORDER BY l.lmode DESC, l.request DESC
